_comment: The orc warlord's cleave: a heavy sweep hitting up to 3 nearest enemies for 50 HP plus 7.5 per level, plus a bleed dot on the nearest enemy for 11 HP plus 2 per level over 4 ticks at 45-tick intervals, both within a 1.6-unit ring on the same 90-tick beat. The boss's only active aura; the shared cadence makes both halves land together every swing. All values placeholder.
name: WarlordCleave
